svg.aria-label: Graph. Five columns: the visitor, the gateway with its ingress, identity, static and wake stages and the scheduler below, seven apps grouped by runtime, ten capability nodes with the number of apps that declare each, and six platform services. The survey app is selected: the rest dims, a request travels from the visitor through ingress, identity, static and wake to survey, then its edges light to files, db on SQLite, cron, identity and static, and from there to the runner and the object store, with the scheduler delivering its cron trigger. Then ttt is selected the same way, its edges reaching kv, ws, identity and static, Redis and the object store.
svg.title: Graph
svg.text: One node per app and every edge its own: the gateway stages it passes, the capabilities it declares, the services behind them.
